title: Theatre, Exhibition, Circus
label: ch:teatro-exposicion-circo
canDo: I can name the theatre, an exhibition and the circus, and say what each word is actually named after: the audience, a putting-out, and the shape of the floor.

payoff.summary: Propose an outing to each of the five places, choosing al or a la without stopping to think, because the -cion ending already told you which one is feminine.
payoff.note: Three words close two A1 points at once. A1-NE18-01 (artistic disciplines) needed teatro and exposicion and had the other six exponents already; A1-NE08-02 (shows and exhibitions) needed teatro, exposicion and circo. A1-NE18-06 (cinema and theatre) is deliberately NOT closed here: it also wants actor and actriz, which remain untaught, and wiring it on teatro alone would repeat the over-claim a review blocked on A1-NE06-05. The chapter carries two retrieval lessons after the three word lessons because the last atom introduced in a track has nowhere to be retrieved otherwise: without them the reinforcement criterion fell short by two and Spanish's attained level dropped from A1 to pre-A1. That is the standing cost of any terminal lesson, not a defect in these three.
